description: Everything Projects setup creates, where its Toolkit source lives, how the daily check-in checks it and how it is brought current. Only Toolkit-governed parts ever change: text inside Toolkit markers, Toolkit-made task prompts and the BINDING, GATE ROUTE and SCHEDULED TASKS memory lines. A check of the form 'hook: <script>' means no daily check: that hook refuses the launch that needs the artefact when it is missing. A check of the form 'rule: <file>' means no daily check either: that file's written rule has the coordinator read the artefact before the work that needs it. Resync kinds: auto (the coordinator does it the same turn, reversibly, with safeguards), owner (the owner acts), report (advice only). Any new thing setup creates adds a row here in the same change.
